pages.text: SYN Market Wire weekly wrap for the week ending 2026-03-20. The SSE All-Share Index closed the week ending 2026-03-20 at 1,896.84 points. The 91-day Treasury bill auction that week cleared at 10.08 percent. Weekly turnover on the exchange was SYN Sh 1,355 million. The top gainer of the week was Dhahabu Bank (SYN).

Officials declined to comment on whether further changes were planned. Analysts at several brokerages said they expected conditions to stay stable through the quarter. Industry groups welcomed the clarity but asked for more investor education. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
